description: Read one hosted pricing model and its versions, newest first: each version's number, source (trained or uploaded), status (candidate, active or retired), size, input spec, training metrics and ONNX operators. The ONNX file itself is downloaded from GET /api/hosted-models/{model_id}/versions/{version}, not through this tool. Answers 404 not_released while hosted models (the hosted-pricing-models release) are not switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with function read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

model_id.description: The hosted model's id: id on a list_hosted_models result.

name: get_hosted_model
